one_liner: A web app that sends polite automatic payment reminders for unpaid invoices of freelancers.
problem: Freelancers wait for late payments and spend time writing reminder emails by hand.
solution: Connects to the invoicing tool, tracks due dates and sends a sequence of reminder emails until the invoice is paid.

target_segments.name: Freelance designers and developers
target_segments.description: Solo professionals in the EU who send 5 to 30 invoices a month.

target_segments.name: Small agencies
target_segments.description: Teams of 2 to 10 people without a dedicated finance person.
